title: HOFAL — Hope for Almajiri
summary: Jamiu was Enactus FUDMA Technical Director and HOFAL Project Facilitator; the team won the 2018 ACT Foundation Leadership Challenge.

evidence.detail: Jamiu confirmed his Technical Director and HOFAL Project Facilitator roles on 21 October 2026.

text:
HOFAL (Hope for Almajiri), Enactus Federal University Dutsin-Ma (FUDMA), Katsina State, Nigeria.
Jamiu confirms he served as Technical Director for Enactus FUDMA and Project Facilitator for HOFAL. The external sources establish the project and team outcomes; they do not name or independently verify his individual role.
ACT Foundation describes HOFAL as an entrepreneurial skills initiative for Almajiri children in Dutsin-Ma, including cap making, shirt branding and Adire production.
Punch reported on 23 January 2019 that the FUDMA team won the 2018 ACT Foundation Leadership Challenge and received a ₦500,000 prize. This was a team award, not a personal award to Jamiu.
Punch reported a first cohort of 37 beneficiaries trained for three months in practical skills including tailoring, shoemaking, cap making, screen printing and tie-dye, followed by certificates and business-starting materials. These are reported programme outcomes, not a claim Jamiu personally trained all beneficiaries.
His exact service dates, individual tasks, budget ownership and longer-term beneficiary outcomes have not been provided. Do not invent these or label HOFAL a digital product or UX research project.
For proof when requested: https://punchng.com/enactus-team-empowers-almajiri-with-skill-acquisition/

title: OAU keynote and panel — AI and youth innovation
summary: Keynote speaker and panel participant at OAU, 17 December 2025: AI Automation & the Creative Future of Youth Innovation.

evidence.title: Certificate of Appreciation
evidence.detail: Certificate supplied by Jamiu and read on 21 October 2026; confirms keynote, panel participation, theme, date and venue.
Post text pasted by Jamiu; profile URL only, not a direct post permalink.

text:
Jamiu delivered a keynote and participated in a panel session at Oduduwa Hall, Obafemi Awolowo University (OAU), Ile-Ife, on Wednesday 17 December 2025.
The summit theme was “Media, Youth & Governance: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence”. This is the summit theme, not a separately confirmed event name.
His keynote title was “AI Automation & the Creative Future of Youth Innovation”. A supplied Certificate of Appreciation explicitly recognises his keynote presentation and panel participation.
In his own Facebook post, Jamiu described discussing product design, AI automation, youth responsibility, how digital tools shape behaviour, why local builders matter, and why ownership beats noise. He thanked OAU for the platform and young creators for participating.
His post emphasises gratitude, preparation, practical action and turning ideas into systems. These are themes expressed in that post, not a comprehensive personality assessment or proof of political beliefs.
No audience size, recording URL, independent event-page link or measured audience outcomes have been supplied. Do not invent these. The certificate was supplied privately for verification; do not claim it has a public download link.
Jamiu supplied Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Handler.Jnr/ and X https://x.com/Handler_jnr/status/1874085242879041923 as social references. The X post body was not accessible and must not be summarised or treated as verified evidence. The agent does not continuously read social accounts.
